name: Add/Edit Task
description: A form screen used to create a new task or edit an existing one. The user fills in the task title, optionally sets a due date, and marks whether it's completed. After saving, they're redirected back to the Task List.
entry_points: Clicking 'Add Task' button from the Task List
Clicking 'Add Task' in the sidebar navigation
Clicking 'Edit' on a specific task from the Task List
information_displayed: Form title ('Add Task' for new, 'Edit Task' for existing)
Breadcrumb link back to Task List

available_actions.description: Create the task (new) or update the task (existing), then redirect to Task List
Discard changes and return to Task List

business_rules: Title is required — cannot save without a title
Due date is optional — a task can exist without a deadline
When editing, 'Mark as done' reflects the current status
When creating a new task, 'Mark as done' defaults to unchecked
After saving, the user is redirected to the Task List
Editing a task that was done clears its done status
edge_cases: User cancels after typing data — discard silently (no confirmation)
User tries to save with empty title — show validation error
User selects a past date for due date — allowed (becomes overdue immediately)
User navigates away (browser back) while on form — same as cancel
open_questions: Should setting a past due date be allowed without warning?
Should the form preserve last input for quick repeated entry?
